latest_release.name: v3.7.0
latest_release.body:
## Homelable 3.7.0

Hello Homelablers !! 

First of all, Thank you to all users who share their needs, concerns or ideas, it’s a real driving force behind Homelable’s growth and improvement!

As you may have noticed, the pace of releases has slowed down, and that’s because of some good news: I’m a dad again :) 

So, to adjust to this new pace, I’m spacing out the releases to include more content and, most importantly, to have more time to test everything. 

So there is the v3.7.0 release, a lot of small improvements and a big new feature : **GIT backup / synchronisation.**
The goal is to be able to save your schemas and documentation, version them in a secure location designed for that purpose and what better way to do that than with Git? 

You can check out the instructions [here](https://github.com/Pouzor/homelable/blob/main/docs/git-sync.md) 

This is a first step, this will allow us to restore from Git to a new version of Homelable or simply restore something after an error. 

See ya 👍 

## Full changelog

### Features
- Push documentation and diagrams to a git repository (#592, refs #579)
- Documentation homepage (#583)
- Emoji icons for documents in the documentation tree (#584)
- Right-to-left documents render in their own direction (#586, closes #572)
- Sync several Proxmox servers, each with an optional name (#588, closes #502)
- Import VMs and containers from an Unraid server (#556) — thanks @Teknicallity!
- Custom node and service icons, from a link or an upload (#595, closes #383)
- Position nodes by X/Y coordinates (#594, closes #593)
- Custom labels for connection points (#568, closes #495)
- Hover highlight: dim unconnected nodes and edges on hover (#537) — thanks @slmingol!
- Reorder the canvas list with up/down arrows (#597, fixes #461)
- New AI / LLM server node type (#585)

### Fixes
- Name subnets after the configured scan ranges, not a /24 (#596, fixes #581)
- Serve the read-only documentation at `/documentation` (#591, closes #589)
- Stop flagging ports 5000/5001 as Synology (#585, fixes #582)
- Create pages and folders inside a Library folder (#577, fixes #574)
- Remap removed handles to a surviving side (#570, closes #445) — thanks @monsterlag!
- Don't let a bare IP match overwrite a row's MAC on lease reuse (#545, fixes #466) — thanks @coddipm!
- Clear dependency-audit and Dependabot findings (#576, #587)

### Docs
- RepoCloud one-click deploy button (#567) — thanks @cosark!
- Document `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` (#566)
